<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
	<!-- Description goes here. -->
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by fractional values. It generates a clock signal with a fractional frequency division (3.5x), using the double-edge clocking technique to achieve half-integer division while adjusting for duty cycle imbalance. By dividing uneven clock cycles and phase-shifting them, a smooth fractional clock output is produced.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
		<input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
		
		<output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
	endports
	
	<implementation>Double-edge clocking technique used to generate a fractional clock output from an input clock. The module counts clock cycles up to MUL2_DIV_CLK (which equals 7 for a 3.5x division). Two uneven clock periods are created: one with 4 source clock cycles and another with 3 source clock cycles. In the next cycle, phase-shifted versions of the divided clock are generated, with one phase shifted by half a clock period and the other by half a clock period. These phase-shifted clocks are then logically ORed together to create the final fractional divided clock output, ensuring it maintains a consistent period.</implementation>
	
	<!-- Define parameters, if needed, below this line. -->
    <!-- Parameters go here. -->
    parameter [3:0] MUL2_DIV_CLK = 7;
    // Phase shift value (half of the total number of clock cycles)
    parameter PHASE_SHIFT = 3;
	
	// Output port type declaration(s) go here.
	reg clk_div;  
	
	// Register and wire declarations go here.
	reg[3:0] cnt_clk;           // Clock counter register
	wire clk_edge;              // Edge-triggered clock signal
	wire[3:0] div_cnt;          // Divided clock counter
	wire odd_clk;               // Odd-numbered clock signal
	wire even_clk;              // Even-numbered clock signal
	wire clk_phase_shifted_odd; // Odd-phase-shifted clock signal
	wire clk_phase_shifted_even;// Even-phase-shifted clock signal
	wire[3:0] cnt_next;         // Next value for clock counter
	
	
	always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
	    if(!rst_n)begin
	        cnt_clk <= 0;
	    end else begin
            cnt_clk <= cnt_next;
        end
	end
	
	
	
	assign div_cnt = cnt_clk % MUL2_DIV_CLK;
	assign clk_edge = |cnt_clk[MUL2_DIV_CLK - 1 -: 2];
	assign odd_clk = (div_cnt >= PHASE_SHIFT);
	assign even_clk = ~odd_clk;
	assign clk_phase_shifted_odd = ((even_clk && !clk_edge) || (odd_clk && clk_edge));
	assign clk_phase_shifted_even = (!even_clk && clk_edge);
	assign cnt_next = (clk_div)?(cnt_clk + 1):(0);
	// Assign statements for output ports go here.
	always@(*)begin
        clk_div</ports></module>
